namedComponentOrder: Your second brain for better decisions.
Research, analyze and organize your ideas in one intelligent workspace.
Research rarely lives in one place. NOVA brings your sources, notes and documents together — so you can spend less time searching and more time understanding.
FROM SCATTERED INFORMATION TO CLEAR DECISIONS.
NOVA connects the information inside your workspace and surfaces the patterns, topics and opportunities worth your attention.
Visual storytelling consistently appears across the strongest content sources.
BUILT FOR DIFFERENT WAYS OF WORKING.
Multiple tabs, tools and saved links.
PDF, websites and notes in different places.
Important details get lost between tools.
Write notes now. Search for them later.
AI helps process the heavy reading.
